text: A prayer of David. Hear, O Lord, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
You are my God; save your servant who trusts in you.
for I call to you all day long.
for to you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
abounding in love to all who call to you.
listen to my cry for mercy.
no deeds can compare with yours.
will come and worship before you, O Lord; they will bring glory to your name.
and I will walk in your truth; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.
I will glorify your name forever.
you have delivered me from the depths of the grave.
a band of ruthless men seeks my life— men without regard for you.
slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.
grant your strength to your servant and save the son of your maidservant.
that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, O Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
